title: JobProgress
description: Worker -> coordinator. Where a running job has got to, reported while it runs. Throttled and best-effort: a dropped frame costs visibility, never correctness, and the final job_result.schema.json remains the authoritative account of what the job produced.

lease_id.description: Required, unlike job_result_chunk: a job re-leased after a failed attempt has a live generation elsewhere, and a superseded generation's progress must not overwrite it.

seq.description: Monotonic per (job_id, lease_id), starting at 0. A frame older than the one already recorded is a replay or a reorder and is dropped.

phase.description: Coarse execution phase. Maps onto the coordinator's internal job state; MCP sees all of these as 'working'.

input_tokens.description: Omitted when the backend reported nothing, so 'not measured' stays distinguishable from 'measured zero'.

model.description: The model the worker's gateway actually selected, which need not be the one requested.
